$comment: Machine-readable lifecycle specification (#1693). Source of truth for state enums, legal transitions and terminal states consumed by the backend, the frontend and contract fixtures. Wire values MUST NOT change: each `states` entry is the exact string persisted or emitted today. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/lifecycle/generate-lifecycle.mjs`; never edit the generated files by hand.

round.description: Per-round lifecycle stored in the backend `rounds.state` column.

arenaGame.description: On-chain arena GameState as defined by the arena contract enum (contract/arena/src/types.rs). `Active` and `Settled` are real contract variants; the backend's legacy `InProgress` string is not.

transaction.description: Lifecycle of a backend-tracked Soroban transaction (backend/src/domain/transactionState.ts).
